steps.text: ...It's autumn.
The hawthorns have sweetened around this time. The children most loved eating hawthorn fruits.
...It's another day.
How much life do I still have left?
When I shut my eyes, I remember so many things of the past...
...and all night, I'm sleepless.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: ...Dusk?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Why are you here...?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You don't seem shocked at all.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Living to this age, the things that shock you, dwindle fast... *cough*, *cough*. But talking to you about this... it all pales in comparison.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: We haven't seen each other... for how many years?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I can't remember. Likely decades.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: ...You really are Dusk.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You still remember me.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How do you know you're not in one of my paintings, with the life you've lived?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I couldn't be.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Are you that sure?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Dusk, you saved me, and I lived in your paintings for such a long time... I can tell it apart.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: This is the bet we made. Whether there'd come a day I'd see through your paintings at a glance, through your worlds, and through you.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: But ever since we parted that day, you never saw me again... I'd thought I'd never have another chance... to talk with you again.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Those who can talk with me like this... are few in the first place.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: ...For such a long time, I've thought back again and again on those days. That pavilion... far from Catastrophes, famine, refuge. A normal pavilion.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: It was just like a dream... *cough*, *cough*.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I believed you'd be quite a good painter. All your life, you never actually took up the brush. Wasn't that such a waste of my teaching?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Painter. A painter, a great painter. After meeting you, who could still call themselves a painter?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: There've been a seldom few. All of them were... strange people.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: ...Then I really have disappointed you.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Who knows.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Just maybe... you surprised me more than anyone else.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Meeting again after so many years... it's like we don't have much to say. I'm so old and worn. I've finished this life of mine. And you... you're still the same you as ever.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Do you have anything you'd like to talk about?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: No... I'm... very content.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You saved me. You gave me the chance to keep living... and even here on my deathbed, you've come.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I'm so gratified, Dusk, to see you... still looking like this.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Your eyes...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I'm very old, Dusk. Illness has tormented me for so many years...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I somehow want to ask you now... watching the people you know die one by one, do you ever feel lonely?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What kind of nonsense is that?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Then what goes through your mind?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Sometimes, I'll feel sorry. Sometimes, I'll feel rueful too.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Look at you... finally willing to speak the truth.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Do you still remember what I told you, about my hometown utterly ruined by Catastrophe?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: It's already far, too far away to try and remember now... it's the reflection in my memories. It isn't behind me anymore. They're a distant place in front of me...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I... I never took up my own brush.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Because if I ever tried in my life to paint, I would only paint... *cough*, *cough*, my hometown.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You clearly can't remember anything of it.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: That's right. Even if I cast my mind back... apart from the single name of 'P'o-shan Village,' I wouldn't remember a single thing.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: It doesn't have much in the way of good memories, but I always end up dreaming of it. Dreaming of so many... homelands. Tell me. In all this lifetime, where is it I've wanted to return?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Dusk.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Could you help me... paint that P'o-shan Village?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I only remember... next to my house, was a pawn shop. Its bookkeeper... wore such beautiful clothes, so gentle and elegant. When I was young, I thought... I'd like to be a bookkeeper too.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: The village didn't have any of those strange moving plates. It was farm fields and gathering places growing unrestrained, and wherever they were made, people would be. Just like oilseed flowers...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: If you wandered a little too far, you'd see a distant mountain...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: That mountain... I always got lost there in my dreams. There were terrible monsters there... Catastrophe clouds, floating around its peak... that's the landscape I can remember most clearly.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Without me saying much more, you have a sense of it too, don't you?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Of course. Not a single part missing.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: How I wish the years could've stayed where I was young. Us, living on the mountains. Me, learning to paint from you, helping you sometimes to grind the ink...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Dusk.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You've met so many oddities. Seen so many changes in the land...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Tell me your view, for me. Would you say... *cough*, *cough*.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Would you say I lived... a blessed life?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yo. You're up?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I've come to understand... why you wanted to bring me here.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...There's all of these people.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wanna go for mahjong? We're missing a fourth.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You... you get out of here. I'm not going.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey, you were all pumped to watch movies last night and now you've gone cold kiddo mode again?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: It's no big deal to like movies. I've got a jumbo collection here.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What even are all those? Churned-out cut-and-paste covers, completely meaningless long names, and just watching makes you fed up. Get rid of them!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: How could you say that!?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I've seen no shortage of operation archives. What kind of person is this Doctor?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh? You sneaked them out? Didn't set Closure off?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You mean that young devil? She didn't mind me. I went there directly.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wha... why would... is she just aiming at me?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What relationship does the Censor have with Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That's another thing entirely. It's no problem, so don't get worked up. Leizi's a down-and-out exile, and she doesn't ever even come to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You mind her that much? Were officials out there hassling you?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hmph. I don't pay mind to that little Censor, but I care about where her Lei Fa originates from... her master, and those elders always watching over us, are no end of trouble.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You say I was bound in my own circle? He burnt scrolls outright, set thorough fire to the mountains and rivers before my eyes, bent on teaching me a lesson. I'm not like you. You get someone constantly berating you and it never dawns on you that you're bugging them.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I annoyed him. Annoyed him to the point I could die. There's nothing I can do with him.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ho ho, some pretty wild stuff went down, huh?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You still haven't told me. What kind of person is this Doctor, and that Kal'tsit? What does you staying here have to do with the two of them?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Also, where are they currently?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Alrighty. I'll tell you everything.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And this way you'll learn... why I like this place so much.
